claims.quote: The western stream catfish, Akysis vespertinus, is an akysid catfish known only from the Ann Chaung river system in Rakhine State, western Myanmar.
Known only from headwaters of the Ann Chaung river system which drains the western face of the Rakhine Yoma/Arakan mountains in Rakhine state, western Myanmar.
